name: Latent Features
description: Explain delivered JavaScript, discover reversible client-side feature controls, switch them ON or OFF, and highlight the virtual code and observed page changes.

settingsSchema.title: Auto-Discover On Navigation
settingsSchema.description: Run a quiet, bounded discovery pass when a top-level page finishes loading.

settingsSchema.title: Read Loaded Libraries
settingsSchema.description: Read only script URLs the page already loaded. Uses cache preference and never guesses chunk or endpoint names.

settingsSchema.title: Include Third-Party Libraries
settingsSchema.description: Also read already-loaded scripts from origins other than the current page. Disabled by default.

settingsSchema.title: Check Public Dependency Advisories
settingsSchema.description: For versions found in already-loaded scripts, use cached npm metadata and OSV advisories. Uses the library throttle and worker limit.

settingsSchema.title: Library Read Thread Count
settingsSchema.description: Concurrent loaded-library reads. Defaults to 1 and is hard-capped at 6.

settingsSchema.title: Library Read Delay (ms)
settingsSchema.description: Minimum spacing between loaded-library reads across all workers. Defaults to 750 ms and never drops below 100 ms.

settingsSchema.title: Libraries Per Scan
settingsSchema.description: Hard cap on already-loaded script resources read during one scan.

settingsSchema.title: Bytes Per Library
settingsSchema.description: Maximum source bytes retained from a loaded script before its stream is cancelled.

settingsSchema.title: Total Library Bytes
settingsSchema.description: Maximum combined source bytes analyzed in one discovery pass.

settingsSchema.title: Candidate Cap
settingsSchema.description: Maximum correlated latent-feature candidates kept in the workbench.

settingsSchema.title: JavaScript Observation Window (ms)
settingsSchema.description: Settling time after the bounded startup reload before runtime evidence is collected. Clamped to 250 through 10000 ms.

settingsSchema.title: Reload After Feature Switch
settingsSchema.description: Reload once after applying or restoring browser-storage flags so startup gates can re-evaluate and the page comparison can be observed.

collectors.name: Latent Page Signal Collector
collectors.description: Collects bootstrap state, browser storage, inline code, DOM feature markers, and loaded script URLs.

collectors.name: Loaded Library Reader
collectors.description: Throttles cache-preferred reads of script resources already observed on the page.

collectors.name: Runtime Feature Observer
collectors.description: Correlates flag-shaped values from responses already delivered to the page.

collectors.name: Delivered JavaScript Purpose Analyzer
collectors.description: Classifies transform, likely purpose, behavior maturity, review priority, and coverage from bounded delivered source.

collectors.name: Instrumented JavaScript Startup Observation
collectors.description: Reloads an explicitly in-scope page once and compares static claims with bounded startup observations while preserving untested stages as gaps.

uiContributions.title: Feature Switchboard and JavaScript Workbench
uiContributions.description: Discover reversible controls from delivered JavaScript and storage, switch multiple flags ON or OFF, inspect virtual code and observed page diffs, then Restore All.
